# Guarded build 2235 publication

This tooling-only branch starts at the unchanged deployed build2234 baseline. It verifies the exact build2235 application candidate, all twelve source-hosted jobs, both canonical manifests, local and hosted real2GiB restoration recovery, original evidence checksums and prior attempts. Native Actions GITHUB_TOKEN performs draft upload/readback before the normal approved PR merge; publication afterward requires the merged tree to match the validated tree and the same frozen preparation certificate. No preliminary tooling merge or direct Cloud asset upload is used. Application source, reserves and infrastructure cannot change on this branch.
